metadata.description: Claude Code tooling for herdr-pager, a desk pager for the coding agents in herdr: a skill that checks your setup and explains the pager.

plugins.name: herdr-pager
plugins.description: Set up and check herdr-pager: checks the install, runs pager-bridge's doctor and explains each failed check, opens the setup page for whatever needs you, and explains the pager's screens and codes. It never handles a Wi-Fi password, and never pairs or revokes a pager itself.
